title: Arrival of Ysgramor in Skyrim
desc: The first human colonists, led by Ysgramor, arrive from the continent of Atmora and establish the legendary city of Saarthal.

title: The Night of Tears
desc: Snow Elves launch a surprise attack on Saarthal and burn it to the ground, attempting to claim the buried artifact — the Eye of Magnus.

title: Return of the Five Hundred Companions
desc: Ysgramor returns with an army of 500 warriors, completely annihilating the Elven civilization in the north and founding the Companions.

title: Betrayal of the Dwemer
desc: Defeated Snow Elves beg the Dwemer for refuge, but the Dwemer blind them with toxic fungi, turning them into the feral Falmer sub-race.

title: The Dragon War & Banishing of Alduin
desc: Mankind rebels against the tyranny of the Dragon Cult, and ancient heroes send Alduin the World-Eater through time using an Elder Scroll.

title: Unification of Skyrim
desc: King Harald eradicates the remnants of the Dragon Cult and unites Skyrim under a single Nordic crown.

title: Exploit of Olaf One-Eye
desc: High King Olaf captures the fierce dragon Numinex and imprisons him inside Dragonsreach fortress in Whiterun.

title: Disappearance of the Dwemer
desc: During the Battle of Red Mountain, the entire Dwemer race mysteriously vanishes, leaving behind deserted underground strongholds.

title: Akaviri Invasion
desc: Serpent-folk from the distant continent of Akavir invade Skyrim, build Sky Haven Temple, and carve the Dragonborn Prophecy onto Alduin's Wall.

title: Rise of Talos
desc: Tiber Septim unites all provinces into the Third Empire, later ascending into the pantheon of Nine Divines under the name Talos.

title: War of the Red Diamond
desc: Wolf Queen Potema of Solitude unleashes a bloody civil war for the Imperial throne, wielding dark magic and necromancy.

title: The Oblivion Crisis
desc: Gates of Oblivion open across Skyrim during Mehrunes Dagon's invasion, leading to the demise of the Septim Dynasty.

title: The Red Year
desc: The eruption of Red Mountain devastates Morrowind, triggering a massive migration of Dark Elf refugees into Windhelm.

title: The Great Collapse
desc: A catastrophic storm collapses most of the capital city of Winterhold into the sea, leaving only the College of Winterhold untouched.

title: Beginning of the Great War
desc: The Aldmeri Dominion wages a devastating war against the Empire, bringing the provinces to the brink of collapse.

title: The White-Gold Concordat
desc: The Empire signs a humiliating peace treaty with the Thalmor, officially banning the worship of Talos across Skyrim.

title: The Markarth Incident
desc: Ulfric Stormcloak forcibly expels the Reachmen insurgents from Markarth, but is arrested for demanding freedom of religion.

title: Outbreak of the Civil War
desc: Ulfric Stormcloak kills High King Torygg in a duel in Solitude, splitting Skyrim into two warring factions.

title: Return of Alduin
desc: Alduin the Firstborn emerges from the time rupture at the Throat of the World and destroys Helgen, signaling the Dragon Crisis.

title: Emergence of the Last Dragonborn
desc: The Last Dragonborn appears, absorbing dragon souls, defeating Alduin in Sovngarde, and stopping the ancient threats of Miraak and Harkon.
